<STRUCT_0001>
Let us formally define the notion of a Zariski open covering of
algebraic spaces. Note that in Lemma <REF_0001>
we have already encountered such open coverings as a method for
constructing algebraic spaces.

Let <MATH_0001> be a scheme.
Let <MATH_0002> be an algebraic space over <MATH_0003>.
A <TEXTITOPEN_0001>Zariski covering<TEXTITCLOSE_0001> <MATH_0004> of <MATH_0005>

<MATH_0007> such that <MATH_0008> is a surjective
map of sheaves.

It is clear that the collection <MATH_0006> of open subspaces of

Moreover, we can turn <MATH_0009> into a category by letting the
morphisms be inclusions of subfunctors (which are automatically open
immersions by Lemma <REF_0001>). Finally,
Definition <REF_0002>
provides the notion of a Zariski covering <MATH_0010>
